text: {"findings":[{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Personal data use without privacy/legal review","detail":"The proposal mines customer-shared coordinates from support chats and stores them against customer profiles, which is personal (location) data repurposed for a new use. Only an engineering design review is recorded; no privacy, legal or data-protection review is noted.","evidence_quote":"Mine the coordinates customers share in support chats and store them against the customer profile","citations":[],"recommendation":"Obtain and record privacy/legal review (purpose limitation, consent, retention, access controls) before proceeding."},{"type":"UNDEFINED_METRIC","title":"Success metric does not match the problem","detail":"The problem is drivers losing time finding entrances, but the success metric is Promise Accuracy median error, which is only an indirect proxy. There is no direct metric for entrance-finding time, delivery time, or entrance-hit accuracy, so the feature's effect is not measured.","evidence_quote":"Promise Accuracy, median error: baseline 6.8 minutes, target 5.5 minutes within 8 weeks.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add a canonical metric that directly measures the problem (e.g., time at drop-off / entrance search time) and justify how Promise Accuracy relates to it."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Experiment duration under 14 days of standard and mismatched to target","detail":"The plan runs 3 weeks, which meets the 14-day floor, but the success target is set over 8 weeks, so the experiment cannot validate the target. Also, the stored entrance only helps on repeat deliveries to the same customer, and 3 weeks of geo-level data may be too short to accumulate repeat-customer exposure. The MDE of 0.5 minutes is smaller than the 1.3-minute targeted improvement, but no power calculation for geo-level clustering is shown.","evidence_quote":"Duration: 3 weeks. MDE: 0.5 minutes, power 80%.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Align experiment duration with the target timeframe and repeat-delivery accrual, and document the power calculation accounting for geo-level clustering (few matched markets)."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"No guardrails for data quality or delivery outcomes","detail":"The change shows possibly stale or wrong entrances to drivers, yet there are no guardrails on delivery failure/not-found rate, driver delivery time, or wrong-location incidents. No privacy-related guardrail such as complaints is included either.","evidence_quote":"Promise Accuracy P90: must not worsen.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails such as failed/missed delivery rate, delivery time per stop, and customer privacy complaints."}]}
